segments.title: Town Hall with Jan and Scrum

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case plugs merch link (!shirt / !merch) and Tony Cabana's Etsy; Papito lip-syncs; raid to Gina attempted.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a week off with a sty and launches the BIN merch store, unveiling a single heavyweight tee designed by Tony Cabana. The news desk covers French civil unrest, a WWII grenade estate sale, an honest Canadian city council candidate, and Elon Musk's promise of SpaceX shares for every American child. Skeletal Munch and Crum debate porn comment etiquette, followed by a town hall with intern Jan and Crum's alter ego Scrum where Case announces his engagement. Trent hosts At the Movies with a degraded camera, reviewing trailers for a Middle East satire, a tank game, Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom, and the Baywatch reboot, while his parole officer Chris supervises. Porn expert Johnny Dick Big makes a brief green-screen appearance before a raid attempt closes the broadcast.
